text: SBI Large Cap Fund is an open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in large cap stocks. It was previously known as SBI BlueChip Fund.
source_title: SBI Large Cap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: The first-tier benchmark for SBI Large Cap Fund is BSE 100 (TRI).
source_title: SBI Large Cap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: For SBI Large Cap Fund, the March 2026 factsheet states an exit load of 0.25% for exit within 30 days, 0.10% for exit after 30 days and within 90 days, and nil after 90 days from allotment.
source_title: SBI Large Cap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: For SBI Large Cap Fund, the March 2026 factsheet lists a monthly SIP minimum of ₹1,000, or ₹500 for a minimum one-year monthly SIP; other frequencies have separate minimums.
source_title: SBI Large Cap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: The March 2026 factsheet lists the minimum investment in SBI Large Cap Fund as ₹5,000, in multiples of ₹1.
source_title: SBI Large Cap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: The March 2026 SBI factsheet shows the SBI Large Cap Fund riskometer as Very High.
source_title: SBI Large Cap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: SBI Flexicap Fund is an open-ended dynamic equity scheme investing across large cap, mid cap and small cap stocks.
source_title: SBI Flexicap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: The first-tier benchmark for SBI Flexicap Fund is BSE 500 (TRI).
source_title: SBI Flexicap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: For SBI Flexicap Fund, the March 2026 factsheet states an exit load of 0.10% for exit on or before 30 days from allotment and nil after 30 days.
source_title: SBI Flexicap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: For SBI Flexicap Fund, the March 2026 factsheet lists monthly SIP minimums of ₹1,000 for a minimum six months, or ₹500 for a minimum one year.
source_title: SBI Flexicap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: The March 2026 factsheet lists the minimum investment in SBI Flexicap Fund as ₹1,000, in multiples of ₹1.
source_title: SBI Flexicap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: The March 2026 SBI factsheet shows the SBI Flexicap Fund riskometer as Very High.
source_title: SBI Flexicap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund is an open-ended Equity Linked Savings Scheme with a statutory lock-in period of 3 years.
source_title: SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: The first-tier benchmark for SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund is BSE 500 (TRI).
source_title: SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: The March 2026 factsheet lists the exit load for SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund as NIL.
source_title: SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: The March 2026 factsheet lists the minimum SIP amount for SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund as ₹500 in multiples of ₹500.
source_title: SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: The March 2026 factsheet lists the minimum investment in SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund as ₹500 in multiples of ₹500.
source_title: SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: The March 2026 SBI factsheet shows the SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund riskometer as Very High.
source_title: SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund has a statutory lock-in period of 3 years from the date of allotment for the scheme's ELSS structure.
source_title: KIM — SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund

text: SBI Mutual Fund says existing investors can use the home page, select 'I am an Existing Investor', and choose 'Get Statements'. Available statements include Account Statement, Capital Gains Statement and Smart Statement.
source_title: SBI Mutual Fund — Ways to Invest / Statements

text: AMFI states that investors can use the e-CAS facility from CAMS or KFintech, and can also view/download portfolio and CAS through MF Central.
source_title: AMFI — Download CAS

text: SEBI describes the Riskometer as a tool used to depict the risk level associated with a mutual fund scheme.
source_title: SEBI Investor — Riskometer

text: AMFI states that fees and expenses charged by mutual funds to manage a scheme are regulated and subject to limits specified by SEBI.
source_title: AMFI — Introduction to Mutual Funds

text: As on 31 March 2026, the SBI factsheet lists the Total Expense Ratio at 1.52% for the Regular Plan and 0.84% for the Direct Plan of SBI Large Cap Fund.
source_title: SBI Large Cap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: As on 31 March 2026, the SBI factsheet lists the Total Expense Ratio at 1.68% for the Regular Plan and 0.86% for the Direct Plan of SBI Flexicap Fund.
source_title: SBI Flexicap Fund — March 2026 Factsheet

text: As on 31 March 2026, the SBI factsheet lists the Total Expense Ratio at 1.60% for the Regular Plan and 0.99% for the Direct Plan of SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund.
source_title: SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund — March 2026 Factsheet
